text:
deploy-bot: [ALERT] Canary rollout 2026-03-17T14:05:00Z -> v2-runtime slice. Canary p95 latency spiked ~2.3x, throughput down ~60%. Auto-revert disabled for this rollout.

maria: paging oncall for runtime, this looks like the canary we just pushed. @ajay you oncall?

ajay: oncall here, looking now. grabbing dashboards and flamegraphs.

incident-bot: Pager: runtime-regression (severity=P2) -> @ajay, @sophie, @maria. Ticket #INC-2026-1123 created.

ajay: quick obs: kernel fallback count rising on canary hosts, batch window collapsing, prefetch queue depth high. KV cache evictions spiking.

ben: rolling rollback or flip feature flag? if prefetch change is the path, kill-switch would be faster.

sophie: confirm config: rollout turned on runtime_prefetch_v2 and changed batch_coalesce_ms from 4->1 as part of perf patch. suspect prefetch+/aggressive batching interacting with kernel IO.

ajay: going to disable prefetch flag for canary slices first. command: `curl -X POST https://flags.redwood/api/toggle -d '{"flag":"runtime_prefetch_v2","value":false,"scope":"canary"}'`

deploy-bot: Feature flag runtime_prefetch_v2 toggled -> false (scope: canary) by ajay.

sophie: after flag flip: p95 down ~25% but throughput still ~40% below baseline. kernel fallback still non-zero.

maria: customer-impact check: CS reports degraded responses for 23 tenants; latency >2x for some bursty workloads. @cs-rep can you confirm outreach status?

cs-rep: CS notified top 10 affected customers, running status update and ETA; support ticket link posted to #support. No immediate escalations from legal/enterprise yet.

ajay: we should roll the canary back and pause the rest of rollout. Flag flip helped but not fully mitigated. initiating manual rollback for canary slice now: `deploy rollback --slice canary --target v1-runtime`

deploy-bot: Rollback started for slice=canary -> target v1-runtime. Ops jobs queued on 6 hosts. ETA ~2m.

zach: collecting logs and kernel traces from affected hosts: `journalctl -u runtime-service -n 500 | gzip -c > /tmp/runtime-logs.tar.gz` and `perf record -a -o /tmp/perf.data`. Uploading to /artifacts/INC-2026-1123.

ops-lead: heads up: schedule an immediate postmortem, but focus on stabilization first. Notify platform infra to check node-level kernel patch interactions.

incident-bot: Customer impact summary appended to INC-2026-1123: 23 tenants affected, peak window ~3m, 5 customers reported user-visible errors, no data loss.

ajay: rollback completed on canary slice. p95 trending back to baseline within 90s. Throughput recovering to ~95% of baseline. No wider rollout yet.

maria: great. mark incident as mitigated and hand off follow-up to eng-runtime for RCA and telemetry changes.

sophie: follow-ups: 1) revert batch_coalesce_ms change and revisit prefetch heuristics, 2) add canary health guard to block kernel-fallback > 0.5% during rollout, 3) add a synthetic workload job to surface KV eviction spikes.

ben: also add an automatic kill-switch that flips feature flags if both p95>1.5x and kernel_fallback_rate>0.5% for >60s.

ajay: created post-incident task tracking: ENGRTM-4989 (RCA), ENGRTM-4990 (telemetry alert), ENGRTM-4991 (canary health guard). Assigning to eng-runtime.

cs-rep: CS will send a follow-up to affected customers with mitigation summary and planned next steps.

incident-bot: Incident changed to status=mitigated. Handoff -> eng-runtime oncall @zach for overnight monitoring.

zach: acknowledged. I'll keep dashboards pinned and watch for regressions. If anything reappears, escalate to SRE.

maria: thanks team. we'll do a blameless postmortem tomorrow at 10:00 PT.

ajay: note for postmortem: attach perf data and kernel logs from /artifacts/INC-2026-1123.

sophie: leaving a short runbook note: when toggling prefetch flag, monitor kv_evictions, kernel_fallback, and batch_throughput for 5m before shifting traffic.

ben: :thumbsup:

[end of thread]
